authorization: User explicitly requested frozen design, implementation, local checks, one bounded local experiment, verification, analysis and roadmap update.
limitations: All 200 vectors previously exposed; grouped outer folds do not remove earlier design adaptation.
Uncertainty conditions on fixed OOF fits; training uncertainty not independently resampled.
Fixed-stop proxy costs do not measure a learned tree or composite-session serving latency.
Finite risk partitions, benefit estimates and pruning procedure do not establish a universal information or policy-family ceiling.
Extra Trees remains an offline diagnostic predictor; shallow artifacts have observed interpreter parity only.
Predicted risk is a fitting-leaf mean, not a confidence bound or conformal risk-control guarantee.
P3c design uses earlier P3b outcomes; matched folds do not remove adaptation. Threshold grids/formulation differ, so do not infer an isolated causal capacity effect.

local_checks.preflight_note: All919 input hashes pass, guarded API import passes, frozen P3b OOF reports reconstruct exactly, no scientific fits.

next_recommendation.not_established: No claim that search-effort adaptation is supported or faster until audited/measured. Fresh development diversity remains an alternative with a precise hypothesis and new entitlement contract.
next_recommendation.scope: Read-only fixed-index query-dependent search-effort feasibility/design audit. Verify actual backend controls, cheap qualified inputs, compatibility, primary timer, ordinary-native baseline and a finite prospective comparison before any measurement.
next_recommendation.why: Risk-separated diagnostics reduce observed loss yet fail activation economics; calibrated OOF selection does not yield a joint qualifier. Prefer scoping a way to change search work without presuming a richer stopping-profile cost can be recovered.
